note: Tama County Conservation park on Wolf Creek 3.5 mi northeast of Traer, in bottomland timber. Five of the eight sites have electric (the county says 'for 10 units'; amperage not posted); self-registration. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm 8 sites (5 electric, 3 non-electric), pit toilets, rural water hydrant, FCFS self-registration, $5 per unit (fees as stored, undated). Amperage, pad lengths and a campground season are not posted (the 'mid April through early November' line is the PARK's hours). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
flags: PHONE: none stored. Tama County Conservation: (641) 484-2231 (https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Tama.aspx). apply.py does not write phone.
SEASON not written: the only season statement is for the park ('Park is open from mid April through early November'), not the campground.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Esri: the open camping/shelter clearing is in the park's south-east corner by the entrance lane; Wolf Creek (~10-15 m channel, creek-size) runs ~200-250 m to the west through unbroken timber.
FIT: no pad lengths or rig limits posted; grass sites off a short lane. Unclear rather than excluded (keep).
PIN: stored 42.22687,-92.42191 is in the timber ~170 m NW of the clearing (~42.2257,-92.4207). Within tolerance; optional re-pin.
WEAK: the camping clearing is partly under canopy; individual pads could not be counted on imagery.
